cheat.cheatgnome.motherlode.desc: The big one: a full stack of 64 emeralds.
cheat.cheatgnome.make_all_happy.desc: Full health, full hunger, clears status effects and puts out fires.
cheat.cheatgnome.free_real_estate.desc: Building supplies: planks, stone bricks, glass and torches.
cheat.cheatgnome.fly.desc: Lets you fly in survival (double-tap jump). You still take fall damage when you're not flying. Press again to turn off.
cheat.cheatgnome.fix_everything.desc: Repairs every damaged item in your inventory.
cheat.cheatgnome.instant_harvest.desc: Grows the crops around you to full size.
cheat.cheatgnome.gnome_gift.desc: A random gift from the gnome's daily gift table, no waiting.
cheat.cheatgnome.settings.locked: Settings need a Cheat Gnome or cheats turned on.
setting.cheatgnome.dailyGift.desc: Garden gnome gives a random gift once per Minecraft day.
setting.cheatgnome.offerings.desc: Give the gnome flowers, gold or treats for rewards.
setting.cheatgnome.mischief.desc: Harmless pranks when you punch the gnome, insult it, or leave it alone for days.
Every player gets one Garden Gnome the first time they join a world.
setting.cheatgnome.prankFakeExplosion.de: A loud bang and smoke. No damage.
setting.cheatgnome.prankWander.desc: The gnome hops to a new spot nearby.
setting.cheatgnome.prankStare.desc: The gnome turns to face you for two minutes.
setting.cheatgnome.prankChickens.desc: Five chickens pop out around you.
setting.cheatgnome.prankRainCloud.desc: A little rain cloud follows you for 30 seconds.
setting.cheatgnome.prankPumpkinHead.desc: A carved pumpkin on your head (only if you're not wearing a helmet).
setting.cheatgnome.prankDecoys.desc: Fake gnomes appear and vanish when touched.
screen.cheatgnome.settings_hint: Tip: sneak + right-click a Cheat Gnome (empty hands) to open these anytime.
cheat.cheatgnome.superpowers.desc: 10 minutes of Night Vision, Water Breathing and Fire Resistance.
cheat.cheatgnome.shoo_monsters.desc: Hostile mobs within 32 blocks vanish (no drops). Named mobs and bosses stay.
setting.cheatgnome.prankCreeperHiss.desc: A creeper hisses right behind you. There is no creeper.
setting.cheatgnome.prankHiccups.desc: Little hops for 20 seconds, with Slow Falling so landings are safe.
setting.cheatgnome.prankSpotlight.desc: You glow for a minute, visible through walls.
setting.cheatgnome.prankSerenade.desc: The gnome plays you a slightly off-key tune.
setting.cheatgnome.prankSwitcheroo.desc: You and the gnome swap places.
gnome.cheatgnome.prank.shrink: The gnome zaps you with a shrink ray!
gnome.cheatgnome.prank.hiccups: *hic!* The gnome gave you the hiccups.
gnome.cheatgnome.prank.spotlight: The gnome puts you in the spotlight!
